corrective_action_taken: Startup stopped before branch creation and reported the dirty paths for human review.
impact: Patch implementation could not safely begin because unrelated local changes might be overwritten.
observed_symptom: git status --porcelain returned existing modified files before patch work.

preventive_rule_candidate.proposal: Patch startup must stop and report when git status --porcelain is non-empty.

root_cause: local worktree contained pre-existing changes at startup
trigger_summary: Startup guard detected a dirty worktree before control-plane patching.
